name: Umesh Pankhania
headline: Managing Director - 22 Years specialising in ERP (JDE & Oracle ERP Cloud & SAP), & DSI® Resourcing Services
about:
Springbok Enterprise Solutions Ltd has been successfully delivering ERP (JDE, Oracle & SAP) projects and services since 2004. 

These services cover the whole spectrum of skills from technical architect, technical and functional consultancy, development consultancy and project management. Springbok delivers innovate services to allow ERP customers to resource their projects using highly skilled specialists with in depth industry experience and knowledge at the most cost-effective rates. 
 
The Springbok offerings range from the provision of individual subject matter experts on a short-term consultancy assignment through to the deployment of virtual teams to work on larger projects. 

Springbok is unique in the marketplace having the ability to provide the highest levels of consultancy skills alongside highly competitive rates for both short and long-term engagements. 

We do this by utilising a mixture of both on-site and Remote skills. We can leverage lower rates without the traditional drawbacks of using remote resources through expert day to day account management. 

We manage this using our unique methodology which clearly defines those areas that can be delivered effectively remotely and those that must be delivered locally, all using fully documented and proven processes. This way our customers enjoy the best of both worlds.
